versions.content: ASIL attribute of safety requirements Safety requirements shall receive an ASIL attribute. The ASIL is stored at an AdminData that contains a Sdg data with gid=”SAFEX” . The contents of this element shall contain an Sd element with attribute gid=”ASIL” . Valid values for this attribute are: • QM • A • B • C • D • QM(A) • QM(B) • QM(C) • QM(D) • A(B) • A(C) • A(D) • B(B) • B(C) • B(D) • C(C) • C(D) • D(D)
